prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1103; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured's policyholder regarding a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Caller reports a rear bumper impact while backing out of a space. Caller states they are experiencing neck and back pain and has not yet sought medical care. Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Initial coverage verification pending.

Entry 2: Coverage confirmed under the collision and bodily injury sections of the policy. Recorded statements requested from both parties. Other driver's vehicle shows rear-end damage consistent with the reported impact. No police report was filed at the scene. Photos of both vehicles requested through the claimant's app upload.

Entry 3: Claimant returned call to confirm that she has been seen at an urgent care clinic and diagnosed with cervical and lumbar strain. Claimant reports stiffness, limited range of motion, and intermittent headaches. Advised claimant of the medical payments coverage available under the policy and that she may submit itemized bills. Claimant indicated she is not seeking legal representation at this time.

Entry 4: Independent appraiser completed inspection of the claimant's vehicle. Repair estimate received and under review. Damage limited to the rear quarter panel and bumper cover. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from property management; manager stated footage is retained for a limited period and will be provided once received.

Entry 5: Follow-up with claimant regarding treatment progress. Claimant reports continued neck and back discomfort but says she is attending scheduled physical therapy sessions. Medical records and billing statements requested with signed authorization. Claim remains open pending receipt of medical documentation, repair invoice, and review of the surveillance footage.
